overview.description: The ProShares Ultra Ether ETF (ETHT) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Bloomberg Ethereum index. The fund tracks 2x the daily price movements of an index that measures the price of Ether. It uses futures contracts to provide leveraged exposure without directly investing in Ether. ETHT was launched on Jun 7, 2024 and is issued by ProShares.
